item.title: [28 Oct] How to Tell a Clear Story with Data
item.description:
When: Wednesday 28 October 2026, 20:00
Where: Online
Source: Meetup — Thessaloniki tech · Meetup

Tom provides a framework that analysts can use to help structure their analytical findings into more of a story/coherent format so that it has a bigger impact. He will then also talk through a real-life example for each pillar of the framework. This is a short 20 minute talk followed by 5-10 minutes of Q&A. Tom is a Senior Commercial Analytics Manager with a background in turning data into commercially useful insight. He also speaks regularly through Toastmasters and is particularly interested in helping analysts communicate complex ideas more simply and effectively.
